notes.title: new games & fixes: No Man's Sky, Cyberdrifter ...
notes.notes:
new games & fixes (updates automatically):

* NO MAN SKY PROBLEM is solved. Oh Yeah! That was incredibly hard. In NMS the movement follows a 3D vector of the joystick on the hand controller (in Stand Out, or Cyberdrifter as well). Whereas other games follow a projected 2D vector of the joystick (Onward, Fallout). We've learned a lot about quaternions, and how to intersect planes with rays using matrices, and many more.

* FALLOUT 4 Pipboy map is fixed and jump is added. Please reload community binding.

* [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/607760/CyberDrifter/?fbclid=IwAR3Yk9u-FF0QT_9JHvbmYums_EbWp8mS50obDCBJ8eoHiCb1YdJXadwvzlo]Cyberdrifter[/url] added!

notes.title: Half-Life: Alyx
notes.notes:
If there ever was an ultimate goal for Cybershoes! - it would be running as Alyx throughout Combine. Now you can. Grab your shoes and enter this VR adventure made by Valve. 

[b]Half Live: Alyx:[/b] We've updated our software. Works across ALL 👍 platforms. If you haven't just started your PC: exit steam using the upper left menu to EXIT and login to steam again: this forces Cybershoes to update.

[b]In-Game Settings: [/b]
Movement: CONTINUOUS
Accessibility/Height Adjust: CROUCH AND STAND

[b]Crouching:[/b] For easy crouching load our hand controller binding! 
[b]Optional: [/b]Deactivate Z-Scaling

Also exciting NEWS for [b]The Walking Dead: Saints and Sinners:[/b] finally the sprint/walk system 👌works as it should. Load our official binding!
